summary: Customer claim filed 21 days post-delivery exceeds the statutory 14-day return and dispute policy window.

claims.statement: Order ORD-71950 was delivered on 2026-09-19 and dispute was initiated on 2026-10-10.
Elapsed return window of 21 days exceeds published merchant return cutoff of 14 days under Policy Gate Rule R-001.

draft_reply:
Dear Arbitration Representative,

We respectfully contest dispute CASE-1003 for Order ORD-71950. The customer received the merchandise on September 19, 2026, and lodged their complaint on October 10, 2026—over 21 days post-delivery.

Our published merchant terms provide a 14-calendar-day notification window for discrepancies. By retaining the merchandise for three weeks, the claim falls outside standard dispute eligibility under Rule R-001. We request dismissal of the claim.

Sincerely,
Merchant Legal & Dispute Resolution
